acceptance: DNS, TLS, profile installation, reverse socket tunnel, and public URL converge on the frozen package commit.
Clean-browser link/reload/realtime/rotation checks pass and old sessions are revoked.
Offline 503 and exact rollback receipt are verified without changing unrelated VPS state.

stories.given: Local DSH and the tunnel are online
stories.goal: Open one long-lived private link on any device without entering account credentials
stories.then: The browser establishes a secure session and enters DSH, with refresh, root-relative resources, APIs, and WebSocket traffic working normally
stories.value: Use the complete currently running DSH, including realtime connections

stories.goal: Inspect remote status, copy the private link, and rotate it
stories.then: All old links and sessions become invalid immediately and one new persistent link is available to copy
stories.value: Manage access without editing server configuration

stories.given: The public site is configured but the tunnel cannot serve DSH
stories.goal: See a clear unavailable page when local DSH or its tunnel is offline
stories.then: The VPS returns a minimal branded 503 page with a retry action and no infrastructure details
stories.value: Avoid an opaque proxy error or login prompt
stories.when: The owner opens the remote URL

exact_next_action: After local units align, preflight targets, apply idempotently, and run public E2E plus rollback verification.

receipt.outcome: The original DSH profile is available through the private HTTPS fragment link with full HTTP/API/WebSocket behavior; rotation revokes old access immediately; the edge serves a branded 503 while offline and recovers through retry.
remaining_risks: The local nginx:alpine syntax canary remained skipped because the image was unavailable; live VPS nginx -t and public-browser evidence passed instead.
DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 is an internal testing release and may require a separately tested compatibility update when upgraded.
